summary.headline: Thunder Omens in Autumn and Winter
summary.text: Thunder omens associated with September through December and the signs Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, and Aquarius, predicting famine, war, disease, earthquakes, crop failures, shipwrecks, deaths of rulers and great men, and varying abundance of grain, wine, oil, fruits, and legumes.
